title: open-science node header
description: The YAML header of a node in a project graph: a task, a result, a paper, a site page or a dataset. It sits as front matter at the top of a markdown file, or as a node.yaml beside a non-markdown artifact.

id.description: Unique within the project. Lower case, digits and hyphens. A task's id equals its directory name under tasks/.

short_name.description: A task's short name: a few words, shown after the project name in session names (the Remote Control list, the prompt box). Lower case, digits and hyphens, at most 24 characters.

privacy.description: public: may be released. soft-private: not released and not in the public map, but may be named elsewhere. hard-private: must not appear anywhere in the release, not even by name. Absent: the manifest's policy.default_privacy.

summary.description: One sentence on what this node established, or why it failed.

verification.description: verified: an agent or human ran a stated check against a provenance record. human-verified: set only by a human.

evidence.description: Path, relative to the project root, to the provenance record and the check that was run. Required unless verification is unverified.

kind.description: A result's kind: figure, table, value, statement, concept, or assumption (taken as given, not established here).

milestone.description: A result the project reports as a main result (one a paper would report); listed in results/README.md.

artifacts.description: Paths, relative to the project root, where the result is stored: figures, tables, data files.

code.description: Paths, relative to the project root, of the code that produced the result.

uses.description: Keys in citations/used.bib of the external works (papers, software, data) the node relies on.
